$schema_note: SACRED character/count bands for Social Media in a Box (Skill 57). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — scripts/prove_bands.py reads THIS file (never hardcodes the numbers) and measures stripped lengths deterministically. Every band is transcribed verbatim from the canonical super-prompts baked in prompts/ (09 FB/IG carousel, 10 LinkedIn carousel, 15 7-part series, 16 reformatter, 08 Sora storyboard). Bands are the DEFAULT floor; a logged client-exact override wins and is recorded on the process certificate (client gets EXACTLY what they ask for — never floored). max:null means an open upper bound (a MINIMUM floor).

bands.$fold_bands_note: v0.2.0 FOLD bands (merge plan C3-C7 / §2.4). Measured deterministically from the fold artifact's declared numeric fields (mirrors how carousel uses images_ready): the podcast mode records durationSeconds/bitrateKbps from ffprobe and coverWidth/coverHeight from the cover; the newsletter/blog modes record character/word counts. Each is a DEFAULT floor; a logged client-exact override wins and is recorded on the certificate.
bands.$f28_quality_note: F28 (2026-09-08): the bands above are the SHAPE floor, never the quality standard. Every post ALSO clears the F28 quality rubric (specificity, voice, usefulness, factual support, distinctiveness, CTA) enforced deterministically by shared-utils/social_content_quality.py: AF-QUALITY-FACT (unsupported factual claim — every fact needs a source URL in the brief; uncertain client facts route to clarification or get omitted), AF-QUALITY-VOICE (a different brand's voice), AF-QUALITY-DUPLICATE (prior-week overlap > 0.60), AF-QUALITY-CTA (approved CTA missing), AF-QUALITY-MEANING-DRIFT (platform variant lost the approved meaning). Short effective copy passes WITHOUT padding: never pad to hit a band. Briefs are built from the approved brand profile, audience, offer, source material, theme and recent history.
